description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {0} due to Aluren, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Mischievous Pup.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mischievous Pup from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mischievous Pup by paying {0} due to Aluren.
When Mischievous Pup enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mirror Image from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
